name: A Wind-Shaped Love
storyline:
Ten years ago, a catastrophic typhoon destroyed an entire city and took Xing Jiu's parents. Rescued by a relief android, he vowed to become an IY—a commander of robotic rescuers.

At twenty, he finally enters the Wind Relief Department and chooses Bai Yi: the world's only emotional android. She possesses every human feeling, yet is shackled as a "tool."

From mutual distrust to quiet intimacy, from a confession beneath fireworks to holding hands through disaster. He thought he'd found happiness—until the typhoon returned.

She pushed him from Death's grasp. She remained in the rubble.

Ten years later, he is a leading researcher. He has spent his life for three more minutes with her.
summary: In a world ravaged by disasters, a young rescuer meets an android girl who feels too deeply—and falls in love. When fate tears them apart, he spends ten years chasing a ghost in white. Can love outlast even death?
